q: A displacement-distance graph describes the displacement of all particles at a particular instant of time.
e: True. A displacement-distance graph describes the displacement of all particles at a particular instant of time. Displacement can be smaller than the path if the path bends.

q: In a displacement-distance graph, displacement of particle is plotted on x-axis and distance moved by the wave is on y-axis.
e: False. In a displacement-distance graph, displacement of particle is plotted on y-axis and distance moved by the wave is on x-axis. This claim used x-axis y-axis in place of y-axis x-axis.
